title: UOS prefix metadata
description: What uos-runtime records about one application's Wine or Proton prefix (specification sections 12.2 and 15.2): the application it belongs to, the runtime and exact runtime version it is on, and the settings needed to reproduce a launch. The file is written by uos-runtime only, lives beside the prefix and is never visible to the application. It must never hold a secret.

timestamp.description: A time in UTC, to the second, as RFC 3339 with the Z suffix.

version.description: A runtime version token, such as wine-9.0 or GE-Proton10-4.

grant.description: A host directory the user has made visible to the application. Whether a grant is honoured is decided again at every launch: a path that is, contains or lies inside a protected location is refused.

path.description: The directory, as an absolute path with every symbolic link resolved.

sync.description: The synchronisation decision of the most recent launch (specification section 8.2).

requested.description: What the application profile asked for.

selected.description: What the launch was set up to use. server is synchronisation through the Wine server; runtime-default means the choice was left to the runtime.

ntsync_device.description: What was found when /dev/ntsync was last looked for.

reason.description: Why the selection was made, in plain language.

migration.description: One explicit move of the prefix from one runtime version to another. A backup is always taken first.

backup.description: The name of the backup taken before the migration.

schema_version.description: The version of this schema. Readers refuse a version they do not know.

app_id.description: The application the prefix belongs to. A prefix is never shared between unrelated applications.

prefix_id.description: The prefix name used by the application's profile.

runtime.description: The runtime the prefix belongs to. proton is Proton started through umu-run.

runtime_version.description: The runtime version the prefix is on. A launch with any other version is refused unless an explicit, backed-up migration is requested.

runtime_build.description: Everything the runtime reported about its build when the version was recorded, such as the distribution's package revision.

pinned.description: Whether the prefix is pinned to runtime_version. A pinned prefix is never migrated.

architecture.description: The Windows architecture of the prefix.

launch_count.description: How many times the application has been launched from this prefix.

graphics_backend.description: The Direct3D translation setting used for launches.

network.description: Whether the application shares the host's network.

grants.description: The host directories the application may see. Nothing else of the user's files is visible to it.

migrations.description: Earlier runtime versions of this prefix, oldest first.
